{'listen': '任何9to5Toys嘅忠實讀者都知道我哋幾鍾意Nomad呢個品牌。多年嚟，呢個牌子一直出緊全業界最出色嘅iPhone保護殼，今年新出嘅iPhone 18 Pro系列亦唔例外。不過新產品喺頭幾個月通常都好少有折扣優惠，除非你用到我哋嘅獨家Nomad優惠碼——喺結帳時輸入9TO5MAC，就可以喺佢哋任何新出嘅iPhone 18 Pro保護殼上即減15%。', 'translation': 'Any longtime 9to5Toys reader knows how much we love Nomad. The brand has been producing some of the best iPhone cases in the industry for years now, and its new lineup for this year’s iPhone 18 Pro series is no exception. However, discounts on new releases are rare during the first few months — unless you use our exclusive Nomad promo code: enter 9TO5MAC at checkout to take 15% off any of its new iPhone 18 Pro cases.'}

{'listen': '提一提大家，喺選購大部分Nomad保護殼嘅同時，加購屏幕保護貼仲可以享有20%折扣優惠，記住要加入同一個購物車呀。', 'translation': 'Just a heads-up: when purchasing most Nomad cases, you can also add a screen protector to your cart for an additional 20% off. Just make sure they’re in the same cart.'}

{'listen': '我自己就非常鍾意Nomad嘅Traditional Leather Case，塊皮一直包到保護殼側邊，仲有雙色設計嘅Modern Leather款。今年我仲有機會試玩埋佢同iPhone 18 Pro襯到絕嘅限量版酒紅色特別版——一如既往咁出色。', 'translation': 'Personally, I’m a big fan of Nomad’s Traditional Leather Case, with leather that wraps all the way around the sides, as well as the two-tone Modern Leather option. This year I’ve also had a chance to try out its limited-edition Bordeaux special edition that pairs perfectly with the iPhone 18 Pro — and as always, it’s fantastic.'}

{'listen': 'Nomad今年仲推出咗全新嘅Rugged Case軍規保護殼，採用咗類似下加州地形圖嘅獨特設計，實物睇其實靚過網站睇好多：', 'translation': 'Nomad has also introduced an all-new Rugged Case this year, featuring a unique design inspired by a topographic map of Baja California — and it looks far better in person than on the website:'}

{'listen': '想睇真啲2026年Nomad iPhone 18 Pro全系列嘅話，可以睇返我哋嘅開箱報道，記住帶埋上面嘅折扣碼一齊去啦。', 'translation': 'For a closer look at the full lineup of Nomad’s 2026 iPhone 18 Pro cases, be sure to check out our hands-on coverage — and don’t forget to bring the promo code above along with you.'}
